title: Clinically Aligned Geometry Constraints for Robust IVUS Vessel Boundary Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2606.18723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) lumen and external elastic membrane (EEM) segmentation is important for quantitative coronary plaque burden assessment. Errors in lumen or EEM delineation directly propagate to plaque area, plaque burden and geometric measurements. However, standard methods prioritising overlap scores often suffer from boundary drift and topology errors, leading to inaccurate clinical measurements. We present GeoCat, a geometry-consistent network that processes 5-frame IVUS clips using dual Cartesian-polar encoders with cross-domain attention and temporal fusion. A differentiable geometry consistency loss directly supervises clinically relevant descriptors including diameters, orientations, and cross-sectional areas. translated_title: 临床对齐的几何约束用于稳健的IVUS血管边界分割
translated_abstract: 血管内超声（IVUS）管腔和外弹性膜（EEM）分割对于定量评估冠状动脉斑块负担至关重要。管腔或EEM描绘中的误差会直接传播到斑块面积、斑块负担和几何测量中。然而，优先考虑重叠分数的标准方法常常遭受边界漂移和拓扑错误，导致临床测量不准确。我们提出了GeoCat，一种几何一致的网络，使用双笛卡尔-极坐标编码器处理5帧IVUS片段，结合跨域注意力和时间融合。一个可微分的几何一致性损失直接监督临床相关描述符，包括直径、方向和横截面积。该模型在来自146名患者的12,242个标注帧上训练，这些数据由两种商用IVUS系统采集。我们使用分割准确性和斑块相关临床指标评估性能。
tldr: 本文提出GeoCat网络，通过可微分的几何一致性损失直接监督临床相关几何描述符，有效解决了IVUS血管边界分割中的边界漂移和拓扑错误问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GeoCat, a geometry-consistent network that uses a differentiable geometry consistency loss to directly supervise clinically relevant descriptors, effectively addressing boundary drift and topology errors in IVUS vessel boundary segmentation.
